series.name: Floor Standing — Premier / vertical cabinet
series.notes: Orient floor-standing / vertical cabinet units (Premier FS and related) use the SAME display codes as the wall splits — all codes in inverter-split.json also apply here (shared platform). This file holds only the floor-standing-specific evidence: E6 sliding-door fault (cabinet door) and Fb indoor DC blower motor fault. Official Gallant-style manuals were not applicable (that is Dawlance); Orient has no public FS service manual — extended codes rest on mbsmpro + Scribd. Service UAN: 0800-ORIENT / 0800-11635.

title.ur: Vertical cabinet units par sliding door fault

meaning.en: On Orient vertical/cabinet (floor-standing) units with a motorized sliding door, E6 indicates the door detection/latch mechanism has failed. Wall splits may instead show compressor overload on E6 (see inverter-split.json).
meaning.ur: Motorized sliding door wali Orient vertical/cabinet (floor-standing) units par E6 ka matlab hai door detection/latch mechanism kharab. Wall split par E6 compressor overload bhi ho sakta hai (inverter-split.json dekhein).

causes.en: Door not fully closed / latch misaligned
causes.ur: Door mukammal band nahi / latch theek nahi
Door mechanism jam ho jata hai

solutions.en: Check the door is fully closed and latch engages
solutions.ur: Check karein door mukammal band ho aur latch lag jaye

solutions.en: Verify door sensor switch operation (power isolated)
solutions.ur: Power band karke door sensor switch check karein

solutions.en: Technician repairs/replaces door mechanism or sensor if needed
solutions.ur: Zaroorat ho to technician door mechanism/sensor repair/badlay

solutions.en: If the code returns after reset, stop and call Orient service (0800-11635)
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad code wapas aaye to band karein aur Orient service bulayain (0800-11635)

source.title: mbsmpro — ORIENT Inverter AC Error Codes (E1–L3 technical guide)

notes.en: Floor-standing/cabinet-specific reading (mbsmpro). Split platforms may show compressor overload on E6 (Electra Fix). Unit-type dependent — see inverter-split.json.
notes.ur: Floor-standing/cabinet wala reading (mbsmpro). Split par E6 compressor overload ho sakta hai (Electra Fix). Unit type par depend — inverter-split.json dekhein.

title.en: Indoor DC Blower Motor Fault (Floor Standing)
title.ur: Floor standing unit ka indoor DC blower motor kharab

meaning.en: The vertical/floor-standing unit's indoor DC blower motor failed (motor assembly). Specific to cabinet/FS Orient units — corroborated by Scribd snippet.
meaning.ur: Vertical/floor-standing unit ka indoor DC blower motor kharab ho gaya (motor assembly). Cabinet/FS Orient units tak mehdood — Scribd snippet se support mila.

causes.en: Indoor DC blower motor failed or jammed
causes.ur: Indoor DC blower motor kharab ya jam

causes.en: Blower controller on indoor PCB fault
causes.ur: Indoor PCB par blower controller fault

solutions.en: Power off; check blower spins freely by hand
solutions.ur: Power off karke blower haath se azaad ghoomta ho check karein

solutions.en: Clear dust/blockage from blower wheel and filters
solutions.ur: Blower wheel aur filters ki gandagi saaf karein

solutions.en: Technician tests motor voltages/continuity and replaces motor assembly if dead
solutions.ur: Technician motor voltage/continuity check kare aur kharab ho to motor assembly badle

solutions.en: If the code returns after reset, stop and call Orient service (0800-11635)
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad code wapas aaye to band karein aur Orient service bulayain (0800-11635)

source.title: mbsmpro — ORIENT Inverter AC Error Codes (E1–L3 technical guide)

notes.en: Floor-standing-specific. Agreeing sources: mbsmpro + Scribd snippet (Fb = indoor DC motor, Floor Standing). Splits use E4/F0 for motor-class faults instead.
notes.ur: Floor-standing-specific. Do sources ittefaq: mbsmpro + Scribd (Fb = indoor DC motor, floor standing). Split par motor class ke liye E4/F0.
